messages:
deploy-bot: Starting deployment gate for service=runtime-api image=redwood/runtime:2026-03-02-v2.5.0 -> target=100% over 60m, initial traffic=5% :rocket:

maria_g: I have dashboard open, watching p99 latency and error-rate. tagging @sre_oncall :eyes:

chris_t: Quick ask — if we see customer-facing errors can we pin specific tenants to v2.4.1 without full rollback?

alex: yes, pinning is supported. example:```
redwoodctl traffic pin --service runtime-api --tenant acme-corp --version v2.4.1
```

deploy-bot: Traffic update: shifted to 15% after 12m. metrics: error-rate=0.6% (+0.4), p99=210ms (+60) — baseline error-rate=0.2%, p99=150ms

sre_oncall: seeing 5xx spike concentrated on /v1/infer, traces show kernel-fallbacks and increased mem pressure. Not huge yet but trending. setting alert threshold to 1.0%

pm_june: reminder — change window til 21:00 PT. prefer containment over full rollback if possible.

maria_g: I want a stop/go call. recommend stop traffic shift and pin affected heavy tenants while we triage. can we hold at 15%?

chris_t: +1 stop. If errors continue after pins we should rollback. Who can run the pins now?

alex: running pin for acme-corp and beta-internal now.

ops_leo: ran commands: `redwoodctl traffic pin --service runtime-api --tenant acme-corp --version v2.4.1` and `--tenant beta-internal` — both succeeded :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Acknowledged pins. Traffic remains 15%.

sre_oncall: after tenant pins p99 dropped for those tenants, overall error-rate still at 0.9% driven by smaller shard of traffic on /v1/infer. logs show new quant kernel failures occasionally.

maria_g: decision: STOP further traffic shifts. do not proceed to 30%. we will not do full rollback yet — try targeted mitigation (disable new kernel path) and run a restricted canary with crash-protection settings.

chris_t: agreed. can someone flip the runtime flag to disable the kernel selector? command: `redwoodctl feature toggle --service runtime-api kernel_v2_selector false`

alex: toggled kernel_v2_selector=false. confirming rollout of the flag to nodes — 92% reported updated.

deploy-bot: Observability note: after flag flip, error-rate moved to 0.35% within 5m, p99 trending back to baseline ~160ms.

pm_june: good to hear. we keep change window open but mark this as hold. next steps: run another small shift (10%) only after 30m and manual go from maria_g.

maria_g: acknowledged. recording decision: STOP/hold at 15%, pinned heavy tenants, disabled kernel selector, will re-evaluate at +30m. tagging for postmortem if regression persists. :memo:

chris_t: thanks all. Alex please prepare rollback playbook in case we need full rollback (commands, expected downtime, contact list).

alex: drafting rollback playbook now, will drop in #eng-releases when done.

ops_leo: leaving a note — metrics snapshots and trace ids saved under run=1802501234 for post analysis.

deploy-bot: Deployment gate state: HOLD. no further traffic shifts.

maria_g: closing call for now. ping me if anything changes. :thumbsup:
